label: Onboarding: Scorecard
mcp_tool_description: Build the POC Test Plan scorecard: every item (1.1.1 to 4.3.5) with its weight, the status recorded with onb_set_item_status, and the live evidence found on the appliance (successful orders, blueprint-provisioned servers per cloud, parameters, tag and LDAP mappings, custom roles, approved orders, quotas, lifecycle parameters, non-stock recurring jobs and rules, CIT tests, webhooks, Content Library extensions), grouped by category with the points possible. Any recorded status wins, pending included; evidence suggests done or pending only for unrecorded items. recordedPendingWithEvidence lists items recorded pending whose evidence is now found: ask the user whether to record them done. Evidence is strict, so a missing item can still be done. onb_score_section limits the report to self-service, rbac, resource-management or extensibility. Call it in the wrap-up phase and whenever the user asks how the POC stands. Read-only; requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
